name: Short Course - PUT Attempts StartDate Change Alongside CompletionDate (StartDate Immutable)
description: SLD POSTs ZSC00001 with no completion date, starting 2025-08-01. Employer approves it. SLD then PUTs the same course with a changed StartDate (2025-08-01 → 2025-09-01) and a new CompletionDate (null → 2026-03-15) in the same payload. StartDate cannot be changed once posted — only CompletionDate can be updated via PUT. Asserts the CompletionDate change takes effect while StartDate is left unchanged at 2025-08-01, in both Learning and Earnings DBs.

steps.name: SLD Creates a Short Course (ZSC00001), No Completion Date
SLD PUTs ZSC00001 with StartDate Changed (2025-08-01 → 2025-09-01, Expected to be Ignored) and CompletionDate Added (null → 2026-03-15)

assertions.name: Learning DB: StartDate unchanged, CompletionDate updated
Earnings DB: StartDate unchanged, CompletionDate updated
